description: A stereo gate that opens and closes on the next clock pulse after you arm it, following an attack-sustain-release envelope

params.text: Sets how long the envelope takes to rise, 1ms to 10 seconds; fully anticlockwise there is no rise at all and the level jumps straight to sustain
Sets the level the envelope holds at, 0 to 100%
Sets how long the envelope takes to fall, 1ms to 10 seconds; fully anticlockwise there is no fall at all and the level drops straight to zero

inputs.text: The pulse train that times the opening and closing; no state changes until a pulse arrives here
A trigger here arms the module, and the next clock pulse opens or closes it; a second trigger before that pulse cancels the arming
A trigger here shuts the envelope and drops its level to zero at once, without waiting for a clock
The left signal to be gated; with nothing patched the left output carries the bare envelope at up to 10V
The right signal to be gated; with nothing patched the right output carries the bare envelope at up to 10V
Lengthens the attack, one second per volt at full attenuverter, added to the knob and capped at 10 seconds; it is read only at the moment the envelope opens
Shifts the sustain level, a tenth of its voltage scaled by the attenuverter and added to the knob
Lengthens the release, one second per volt at full attenuverter, added to the knob and capped at 10 seconds; it is read only at the moment the envelope closes

outputs.text: The left signal at the envelope's level
The right signal at the envelope's level
10V for as long as the envelope is open, 0V otherwise, or a 1ms pulse at each change with 'Trigger on Gate Out' ticked

notes: nothing happens until a clock is patched: an ARM trigger only arms the module, and the change takes effect on the next pulse at the CLOCK jack.
menu: Initialize on Start — comes up closed when Rack loads a patch, instead of resuming whatever state it was saved in
Disable Unarm — stops a second ARM trigger from cancelling an arming before its clock pulse arrives
Trigger on Gate Out — replaces the held gate at the GATE output with a 1ms pulse each time the state changes on a clock

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.5:
continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.6:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 1V.
